record.context_brief: Centralizer and normalizer of the diagonal torus
record.original_question: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let k[x1, ..., xn] with n > 1, let Aut*_k(k[x1, ..., xn]) be the subgroup of polynomial automorphisms with Jacobian determinant 1, and let T = {diag(t1, ..., tn) | product_{i=1}^n ti = 1} be the diagonal torus acting by xi -> ti xi. What are the centralizer and the normalizer of T inside Aut*_k(k[x1, ..., xn])?

evidence.quote: T := {sigma := diag(t1, . . . , tn) in Aut*_k k[n] | sigma(xi) = tixi, ti in k, product_{i=1}^n ti = 1}.
Problem 1.2. Describe the centralizer and the normalizer of T in Aut*_k k[n].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$, and fix an integer $n>1$. Let $k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ be the polynomial algebra in $n$ variables, and denote by $\operatorname{Aut}^*_k k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ the group of $k$-algebra automorphisms $\sigma$ whose Jacobian determinant $\det(\partial\sigma(x_i)/\partial x_j)$ equals $1$. Consider the algebraic torus
$$T=\Bigl\{\operatorname{diag}(t_1,\dots,t_n)\;\Big|\;t_i\in k^\times,\;\prod_{i=1}^n t_i=1\Bigr\}\subset \operatorname{Aut}^*_k k[x_1,\dots,x_n],$$
where $\operatorname{diag}(t_1,\dots,t_n)$ denotes the automorphism sending $x_i\mapsto t_i x_i$ for each $i$.

Determine, explicitly, the centralizer $Z_{\operatorname{Aut}^*_k k[x_1,\dots,x_n]}(T)$ and the normalizer $N_{\operatorname{Aut}^*_k k[x_1,\dots,x_n]}(T)$ of $T$ in $\operatorname{Aut}^*_k k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in Popov's list of open problems from a 2002 workshop on group actions on rational varieties. A targeted web search did not turn up a paper that explicitly computes the centralizer and normalizer of this diagonal SL-type torus inside the Jacobian-1 polynomial automorphism group, so its current status could not be verified.

status_evidence.title: Problems for problem session, V. L. Popov (arXiv:math/0504517)
status_evidence.snippet: This paper comprises problems formulated at the Open Problems Session of the Workshop on Group Actions on Rational Varieties (McGill/Montreal, March 2002).
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as an open problem in a problems-session collection.

status_evidence.title: Polynomial Automorphisms, Deformation Quantization and Some Applications
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of centralizer-type problems and torus actions in the theory of polynomial automorphisms; recent linearity results for positive-root torus actions are discussed, but the specific centralizer/normalizer of the SL-diagonal torus is not resolved.
status_evidence.claim: Recent surveys discuss related centralizer and torus-linearization questions without reporting a solution to this specific problem.
